wins.label: Strong Q2 Performance
wins.evidence: This morning, we reported another very good quarter with net income of $4 billion, earnings per share of $1.96 with an ROTCE of 8.7%. Revenues were up 8% and 3 of our 5 businesses had record second quarter revenues.

wins.label: Services Business Momentum
wins.evidence: Services continues to show why this high-returning business with 23% ROTCE for the quarter is our crown jewel. Revenue was up 8%, with robust growth in both loans and deposits.

wins.label: Markets Business Growth
wins.evidence: Markets revenues were up 16%, the best second quarter since 2020. In fixed income, the flows we saw in rates and currencies were particularly strong, backed by client momentum.

wins.label: Wealth Business Performance
wins.evidence: Wealth delivered a pretax margin of 29% as revenues were up 20%, with each line of business growing significantly and noninterest revenue up 17%.

wins.label: Capital Return to Shareholders
wins.evidence: During the quarter, we returned over $3 billion in capital to our common shareholders, which includes $2 billion in share repurchases.

risks.label: Macro Uncertainty
risks.evidence: We did see inflows slow this quarter as clients were cautious amidst macro uncertainty.

risks.label: Transformation Costs
risks.evidence: We expect to see some of the increase in transformation expenses in '25 will trend down over time.

risks.label: Regulatory Uncertainty
risks.evidence: There is still some uncertainty as to what the SCB will ultimately be, the reduction will be, depending on whether it's an average of the last 2 years or not.

risks.label: Credit Risk
risks.evidence: We have a net ACL build of $333 million, primarily related to transfer risk associated with our clients' activities in Russia.

risks.label: Stranded Costs
risks.evidence: There's still about $1.2 billion left [of stranded costs] that will trend down over the next couple of years.
